name: Pervert Action: Timelapse
source:
Shuji has lost the last month of his life. Now he finds in that time he's been dating a group of gorgeous, out-of-his-league girlfriends. What happened in that time?
And will he be able to turn a group of jealous ex-girlfriends into a harem? Choose how you build your skills and which women you’ll focus on, as you date the girls in order to unravel the mystery
[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/BBBen]Patreon[/url]]

而他能否将一群嫉妒的前女友变成后宫呢？当你与女孩约会以解开谜团时，选择如何培养你的技能以及你将关注哪些女性
